item.title: A Personal Response to a New World Order
item.description: Canadian PM, Mark Carney visited Australia and spoke at Parliament House. David Speers wrote an analysis of his speech on ABC's analysis page about the new world order. Raymond Minniecon wrote this article out of concern for our future.

item.title: Shock jocks, prophets and God as a maggot
item.description: What do shock jocks, prophets and maggots have to teach us about the nature of God? Dr Paul Mercer gives us a raw account of God's willingness to get into our mess to heal us.

item.title: Walking Forward into the Past
item.description: Revd Canon Shannon Smith writes, 'Sitting back and watching the Yoorrook Commission come together and transforming how a State moved forward into the past captivated my mind and heart. Bringing the commission together and listening to the shared truth and evidence given was enough to rock the core of any who has engaged or even took up an interest in the proceedings.'
